description.value: West Point Cycles is a long-running full-service bicycle retailer with multiple Vancouver locations, carrying a wide range of road, mountain, commuter, folding, and electric bikes from brands including Trek and Brompton. The West 10th Avenue store offers comprehensive mechanical services alongside a deep inventory of parts and accessories relevant to loaded touring, including Ortlieb bags and Schwalbe Marathon Plus tires. A staffed workshop and walk-in estimate policy make it a practical stop for touring cyclists needing mechanical support in Vancouver's west side.
